newsitem.title: UK: Ship with aluminium shifts cargo off Newfoundland.
newsitem.headline: Ship with aluminium shifts cargo off Newfoundland.

text.p: Bulk carrier/container vessel Columbialand, carrying aluminium slabs, shifted its cargo in bad weather off Newfoundland, Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service said.

Aluminium slabs in the holds of the 31,900 dwt Singapore-flag vessel broke their lashings and shifted in adverse weather east of Cabot Strait in lat 46 30N, long 57 50W on January 26. Efforts to resecure the cargo were unsuccessful.
Columbialand sought refuge and proceeded to St. John's, Newfoundland.
It sailed from Port Alfred on January 24 bound for Antwerp.
